STATE OF NEW MEXICO
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE LABOR RELATIONS BOARD
In re:
INTERNATIONAL BROTHERHOOD
OF TEAMSTERS, LOCAL 492,
Petitioner,
and PELRB No. 307-26
SOUTH VALLEY ACADEMY,
Respondent.
ORDER
THIS MATTER comes before the Public Employee Labor Relations Board at its regularly
scheduled meeting on June 2, 2026, upon the Petition filed January 8, 2026, to Certify the
Petitioner as the exclusive representative of a bargaining unit consisting of employees holding
instructional positions at South Valley Academy. The Board, having reviewed the file, and being
otherwise sufficiently informed, finds and concludes: The Petition does not raise a question
concerning representation and it presents sufficient facts including sufficient support among the
employees in the petitioned-for positions to be represented by Petitioner pursuant to NMAC
11.21.2.33.
Upon review of the submissions and no one appearing in opposition to the Certification, the
Board by a vote of 3-0 hereby affirms and ratifies the Certification of Representation issued by the
Executive Director on April 23, 2026, including the findings therein..
6/9/2026

Nan Nash, Board Chair
